subject: Onboarding QC packet + temporary access / contractor log request
messages:
From: Sara Park <sara.park@novushealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novushealth.com
Date: 2026-12-13T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: onboarding QC packet + temporary contractor access log for SOC2 sampling

Hi Markus,

We're preparing our SOC2 auditor packet and need a compact onboarding QC bundle covering the last quarter (Sep–Nov 2026) for the contractor cohort that had elevated privileges during the pilot. Specifically we need:

- Confirmed training completion list (names, role, training id, completion date).
- Redacted identity proofs (driver's license or passport) with a clear redaction technique; we ask for one sample for auditor review.
- Temporary access/badge issuance log and door swipe records (contractor badges only) for Nov 2026.
- A short note describing your redaction process and retention policy for background check artifacts.

Can you provide a single ZIP with the QC checklist pre-filled and the CSV log, or point to a shared drive? Auditor wants this by COB Wednesday (2026-12-15) for inclusion in the sampling set.

Thanks,
Sara Park
Senior Security Analyst, Novus Health
procurement@novushealth.com

(Attachment: requested_fields_template.csv suggested format)
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Sara Park <sara.park@novushealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-13T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: onboarding QC packet + temporary contractor access log for SOC2 sampling

Hi Sara — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Marissa (HR / onboarding), Ben (Compliance), and Jonas (infra / access logs) so we can assemble the packet. High-level plan:

- Marissa: we'll populate the training completion CSV and include a signed attestation for each contractor.
- Jonas: we'll pull the contractor badge issuance and door swipe CSV; we'll filter to contractor badge IDs and provide the Nov 2026 slice.
- Ben: we'll generate a short redaction methodology note and produce a one-sample redaction PDF for the auditor to confirm.

Delivery target: aim to share a Drive folder and ZIP by EOD 2026-12-14 so you have a day to review before your COB deadline. If the auditor needs anything anonymized differently (e.g., hashed PII), flag that immediately — we can provide SHA256 hashed identifiers alongside redacted copies to demonstrate chainability.

Marissa, Ben, Jonas: can you confirm ETA below and add any constraints (e.g., export reformatting, withheld fields) in your reply? I'll start the shared Drive folder and post the link once downloads are staged.

Markus
Head of Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

Hi all — final delivery from Compliance/Infra. Packaging notes below and links to the folder.

What we uploaded to the shared Drive (link below):
- ZIP: novus_onboard_qc_packet_2026-12-14.zip (contains CSVs, redacted PDFs, HR attestation, and a short redaction procedure document).
- contractor_temp_access_log_2026-11.csv: filtered door-swipe export with contractor badge IDs and timestamps (internal badge IDs replaced with reversible token hashes; we include a token-to-hash mapping stored in a separate encrypted file available to your auditor on request).
- onboarding_qc_template_filled.csv: filled per requested fields (QC columns included).

Redaction philosophy (short): PII is redacted at field level; we keep a mapping for audit only (encrypted, limited access). Redaction sample uses a one-way SHA256 for full SSN and shows last-four in clear for identity correlation. Background check artifacts are delivered as redacted PDFs; originals are not shared. Retention excerpt and signed HR attestation included.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3Cnovus-onboard-qc
HubSpot record: HS-22945

If you need the raw swipe export (full badge IDs) for the auditor, we can provide a secure SFTP transfer under an executed NDA addendum — let us know. Otherwise this package should satisfy SOC2 sampling needs.
